entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This place is huge... yet there are no guards?[n]That seems suspicious...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But the Treasure's up ahead, right?[n]We don't got a choice but to keep goin'.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I guess that's true... but we need to make[n]sure we're ready for whatever might be[n]ahead.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What do you think, Joker?[n]Should we continue onward?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah, good call. It's better to be[n]safe than sorry.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I get it... The gym's some kinda holy place[n]for him. He's a god there.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I can't believe he can think like that...[n]especially after what he did to Shiho...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: God, that bastard makes me so freakin' sick![n]Just you wait, Kamoshida!

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: I see... So you're the ones who tampered[n]with the library.

entries.speaker: Mysterious Voice
entries.en: It seems my time waiting here has paid off...

entries.speaker: Guard Captain
entries.en: Just as that ape there said, this place is a[n]holy ground for our great King Kamoshida.

entries.speaker: Guard Captain
entries.en: It is preposterous for miscreants like[n]yourselves to come waltzing in like[n]this!

entries.speaker: Heavenly Punisher
entries.en: You will pay for foolishly defying[n]King Kamoshida... with your lives!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I knew this would happen! Well, we don't[n]have a choice! Let's take it down!
